issues.on_page: Statement of Activities prints one 'Taxes' line; fund schedules print 'Taxes' per fund only

The amounts are right (434,543 + 6,802 + 225,695 + 5,734,184 = 6,401,224). Defensible, but receipts[3] (lodging) and receipts[4] (property tax, 77,766 + 147,929) and the matching detail[37]/detail[38] are inferences.
